what: Failed login attempts from this source in the last hour
if_higher: Above 10: an automated attack is likely

what: Distinct usernames tried from this source in the last hour
motivation: Spraying tries one common password against many accounts
if_higher: Above 5: many accounts targeted from one source

what: Outbound data volume divided by this host's 30-day baseline
motivation: Stolen data has to leave the network
if_higher: Above 5: far more data leaving than usual

what: 1 if the host talks to an external destination it never contacted before
motivation: Attack infrastructure is new to the victim

what: How regular the host's outbound connections are, 0 (random) to 1 (clockwork)
motivation: Malware checks in with its controller on a timer
if_higher: Above 0.7: clockwork-like call-outs; legit for some server jobs

what: Share of this activity outside the user's working hours
motivation: Attackers work when nobody is watching
if_higher: Above 0.6: mostly off-hours; normal for some servers

what: How rare the responsible process is across the fleet, 0 (everywhere) to 1 (unique)
motivation: Malware runs processes nobody else runs

what: Age of the destination domain in days since registration
motivation: Attackers register fresh domains for each campaign
if_lower: Under 30 days: a freshly registered domain
